enso.rule: CPC official RONI of the winter the lead window covers: strong El Nino if NDJ or DJF >= 1.5, El Nino if >= 0.5, La Nina if NDJ or DJF <= -0.5

na: SEAS5 expects the Pacific ridge regime on 3% of January days against 23% in its own climate (less often; members 2–5%), and its hindcast has significant skill for that regime there (r 0.37, 90% interval 0.10 to 0.60, p 0.016, passes the false-discovery test).

SEAS5 expects the Pacific ridge regime on 4% of JFM days against 24% in its own climate (less often; members 3–6%), and its hindcast has significant skill for that regime there (r 0.54, 90% interval 0.35 to 0.69, p 0.000, passes the false-discovery test).

SEAS5 expects the Pacific trough regime on 45% of December days against 27% in its own climate (more often; members 40–51%), and its hindcast has significant skill for that regime there (r 0.40, 90% interval 0.20 to 0.57, p 0.011, passes the false-discovery test).

SEAS5 expects the Pacific trough regime on 42% of DJF days against 27% in its own climate (more often; members 38–45%), and its hindcast has significant skill for that regime there (r 0.53, 90% interval 0.16 to 0.75, p 0.001, passes the false-discovery test).
In the hindcast's 14 El Niño winters the Pacific trough regime was observed +8 points in DJF (significant), and SEAS5 predicted +5 — same sign, also significant.
In the hindcast's 14 El Niño winters the Pacific ridge regime was observed -9 points in JFM (significant), and SEAS5 predicted -11 — same sign, also significant.
ea: SEAS5 expects the NAO− / Greenland blocking regime on 4% of October days against 16% in its own climate (less often; members 3–6%), and its hindcast has significant skill for that regime there (r 0.46, 90% interval 0.22 to 0.64, p 0.005, passes the false-discovery test).

SEAS5 expects the Atlantic ridge regime on 29% of October days against 20% in its own climate (more often; members 25–33%), and its hindcast has significant skill for that regime there (r 0.41, 90% interval 0.16 to 0.60, p 0.010, passes the false-discovery test).
